Mr Reeves sustained injuries in a workplace incident on 5 June 2023 at the Warwick Distribution Centre. According to the incident report, he was clipped by a slow-moving forklift travelling at approximately 5 km/h. He sustained a hairline fracture of the left tibia and minor bruising to the lumbar region. He was taken to Westmead Hospital where he was admitted for 3 days before discharge.
